av_event.line_text: Yeah. No, that's fair, that. That's a better way of doing it than mine, to be honest. My sister says I've got no tact.
av_event.what: Behind Ryan, one of the unframed gig posters above the single bed comes loose from its Blu Tack at a top corner and flops down, so it hangs diagonally against the pale grey wall for the rest of the call. Ryan doesn't turn round.
